proc main (): eff loaded integer :=
  let strong x: pointer = create(Ivalignof('signed int'), 'signed int') in
  let strong p: pointer = create(Ivalignof('signed int*'), 'signed int*') in
  let strong a_508: loaded integer = bound(pure(Specified(10))) in
  store('signed int', x, conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_508)) ;
  let strong a_509: loaded pointer =
    bound(
      let weak a_510: pointer = pure(x) in
      pure(Specified(a_510))
    ) in
  store('signed int*', p, a_509) ;
  let strong a_516: loaded integer =
    bound(
      let weak a_515: pointer =
        let weak a_511: loaded pointer =
          let weak a_514: pointer = pure(p) in
          load('signed int*', a_514) in
        case a_511 of
          | Specified(a_512: pointer) =>
              let weak a_513: boolean =
                memop(PtrValidForDeref, 'signed int', a_512) in
              pure(
                if a_513 then
                  a_512
                else
                  undef(<<UB043_indirection_invalid_value>>)
              )
          | Unspecified(_: ctype) =>
              pure(undef(<<UB043_indirection_invalid_value>>))
        end in
      load('signed int', a_515)
    ) in
  kill('signed int', x) ;
  kill('signed int*', p) ;
  run ret_507(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_516)) ;
  kill('signed int', x) ;
  kill('signed int*', p) ;
  pure(Unit) ;
  save ret_507: loaded integer (a_517: loaded integer:= Specified(0)) in
    pure(a_517)
